scenarios.name: Change panel title visibility from an inactive tab

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active with the full 3D Model ribbon selected in the MCAD Software
the user opens the inactive Sketch tab context menu
3D Model remains selected and Show Panel Titles is checked
the user clears Show Panel Titles
the menu closes and the 3D Model panel titles are hidden
the Tools panel titles are also hidden
the user opens the Tools tab context menu
Show Panel Titles is unchecked and Tools remains selected
the user selects Show Panel Titles
the menu closes and the Tools panel titles are visible
the 3D Model panel titles are visible
